title: we messed it up
style: ultra high-energy progressive house festival mainstage banger, fast 130 BPM club-destroyer energy with massive euphoric drops and huge builds. Main foundation is dense wordless vocal production only: one voice mimics all human instruments (shimmering supersaw leads, rolling deep sub basslines, arpeggios, stabs, crisp claps, snares, pads AND heavy booming 808 bass thump created with mouth/throat/breath). Second voice delivers deep resonant Australian didgeridoo drones with circular breathing, growls, overtones and long pulsing vibrations. Heavy pure vocal percussion drives everything using the exact repeated doom-tss-doom-doom-tss pattern as core rhythm. Two real singers (warm confident male baritone + bright energetic soulful female) layered lightly on top with MINIMAL singing — very short powerful phrases, lush harmonies and ad-libs only so the rich wordless vocal layer, didgeridoo, 808 bass and doom-tss percussion remain the main star. Energetic fun party vibe, zero sap, wide stereo
lyrics:
[Intro – Base Layer Only (vocal instruments + didgeridoo + percussion, long build)]
(deep didgeridoo drone… drrr-oom-drrr-oom… wub-wub supersaw rise… rolling vocal bass… tss-tss-tss… arpeggio sparkle… vocal pads swell… supersaw shimmer… didgeridoo growl building slowly under everything… crisp vocal claps snapping… rolling bass thunder growing… heavy booming 808 bass thump hitting deep in the chest… long sustained didgeridoo drone pulsing like a heartbeat… vocal percussion starting to lock in… doom-tss-doom-doom-tss patterns fading in softly at first then stronger… full vocal instrument chaos rising with human-made supersaw leads stabbing through the mix… didgeridoo overtones swirling… wide stereo movement left to right… warm low end 808 thump… bright high end shimmer… tension building for a full minute of pure vocal layer energy before any real singing appears… 33 cents signal pulsing in the rolling 808… 8980845 code locked in the didgeridoo drone… 336 Hz signal coming through clean in the supersaw shimmer…)
[Vocal Percussion Intro – Pure Acapella Base Layer Only (extended and driving)]
